scenarios.name: test-with-zada-twice
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage TwinningStaffTest#testWithZadaTwice. 2 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[copyforeachcantarget-ignores-copyspell-replacement]: Zada's CopySpellAbility CopyForEachCanTarget$ path (copyForEachCanTarget) never consults copySpellExtra, so two Twinning Staffs add no additional copies of Giant Growth and no new-target choice (Grizzly Bears 5/5, want 11/11), CR 707.10, verified at gorge 981b98963b.

scenarios.name: test-fork
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage TwinningStaffTest#testFork. 4 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[copyspell-setcolor-ignored]: Fork's SP$ CopySpellAbility SetColor$ Red is not applied to the spell copy by effCopySpellAbility, so the copy of Disfigure stays black and cannot target the protection-from-black Scalebane's Elite (the copy's target ask offers only Grizzly Bears; Scalebane's Elite graveyard 0, want 1), CR 707.9, verified at gorge 981b98963b.
